name: 45383 · West Milton, OH
findings: ZIP 45383 (West Milton) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45383 (West Milton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45383 (West Milton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
